What is Project Retract?

Project Retract is an OGFN project built around bringing back the Fortnite you remember. It's community run, and it's one of the biggest OG Fortnite servers on Discord.

Questions

What is OGFN?

OGFN stands for OG Fortnite. It's the name for community projects that let players revisit older versions of the game.

Which season can I play?

Chapter 2 Season 4 is live right now.

Where do I get updates?

In the Discord server. News and announcements are posted there first.

Is this made by Epic Games?

No. Project Retract is a fan community project and is not affiliated with Epic Games or Fortnite.
